name: artifact-migration
description: Migrate Claude Artifacts (claude.ai HTML/React pages — dashboards, trackers, calculators, prototypes) into Hex. This coding agent reads the artifact's source, published files and artifact-database rows, then runs a data-grounding gate that maps every number onto a real warehouse column so mock data never ships; Hex's notebook agent builds a generative app on a natively-gated SQL data layer; then it's verified with a SQL-fidelity gate (including a mock-constant sweep) and a visual-QA loop.
